name: Yazi Explorer
description: Open Yazi (terminal file manager) in a herdr pane

command: command -v yazi >/dev/null 2>&1 || { [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ] && command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec brew install yazi; echo "Yazi is required. Install it from https://yazi-rs.github.io/docs/installation" >&2; exit 1; }

actions.title: Open file explorer
command: DIR="$(bash "$HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT/bin/resolve-dir.sh")"; exec "${HERDR_BIN_PATH:-herdr}" plugin pane open --plugin ray.file-explorer --entrypoint explorer --placement split --cwd "$DIR"

actions.title: Open file explorer (new tab)
command: DIR="$(bash "$HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT/bin/resolve-dir.sh")"; exec "${HERDR_BIN_PATH:-herdr}" plugin pane open --plugin ray.file-explorer --entrypoint explorer --placement tab --cwd "$DIR"
